summary: Introduces the collection creator path, explaining collections, sharing via Galaxy or Automation Hub, that the Ansible community package is ansible-core plus community collections, and that the guide walks from first module or role to inclusion in the package.
questions: What is in the Ansible community package?
What does the collection creator path cover?

answer_card.title: The collection creator path
answer_card.answer_md: The Ansible community package is `ansible-core` (including `ansible.builtin`, maintained by the Core team) plus community-maintained collections. The creator path walks you from an idea for a module or role to having your collection included in that package, via milestones covered in the following sections.
